text: {"name":"rf_init_calibration_cache","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Loads RF calibration values from the RF or SMC interface once, clamps them to supported ranges, and caches them with the current RF status.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v2":"calibration_state","v4":"rf_mode_flags","v6":"rf_status","v7":"temperature_calibration_level"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Cache initialized flag; set to 1 after loading."},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Signed temperature calibration level, clamped to -7..8."},{"offset":3,"meaning":"Marker set to 0x80 after initialization."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"RF/SMC parameter value, defaulted to 15 and capped at 31."},{"offset":6,"meaning":"Value returned by rf_get_status()."}]}
